notes: Canonical file written 2026-09-06 by this event's initial research, after reading both proposals for this id (from-m3-full-report-2026-10-02 and from-wholesale-trade-2026-10-08), which are now shadowed. Both proposals' GDPNow-trigger claim is SUPPORTED and independently replicated: construction spending is one of eight TRIGGER releases in the Atlanta Fed workbook, and 14 of 14 2026 editions drew a posted vintage. What this research adds is the fact that separates this edition from every other one the calendar tracks, and it is about the DATE rather than the model: 2026-10-01 is day 1 of FY2027, and the two federal funding lapses of the last thirteen years both began on an October 1 and both destroyed exactly this slot — the August-reference edition. Census's own 2013 announcement (Wayback capture 2013-11-05) reads "The Value of Construction Put in Place for August 2013 will be released October 22, 2013"; in 2025 the October 1 row is simply absent from the calendar and the August-2025 data appeared 2025-11-17, a 78-day lag against a 32-day norm. That exposure is RETIRED for this edition: PL 119-103 was signed 2026-09-02 and funds agencies through 2026-12-11, so 10-01 sits inside the funded window and the next exposed edition of this series is the untracked January 2027 one.
